- Data retention note: we added language on audit logs and retention (MSA §4.3)

Dana — thanks for sending these over and for the clear asks. We'll take the following approach so you have full visibility:

1) Commercial touch (Marissa) will confirm pricing and PO timing.
2) Legal (Karthik) will review MSA redlines and propose counter-language; expect a short readout.
3) I will consolidate a mutual action plan and proposed dates (target: counter-redlines by 2028-06-17).

A couple quick clarifying questions so we can be precise in our redline:
- Is the 18-month term firm, or would you accept an 18-month term with a 30-day early-terminate-for-convenience option?
- On audit logs: do you need a specific retention window (e.g., 90/180/365 days) or is the principle + ability to produce logs sufficient?

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Jun 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal + capacity increase: redlines attached

Hannah / Marissa — I reviewed ACME's marked MSA and have three substantive items and a handful of minor cleanups:

1) MSA §7.2 (indemnity) — ACME added a broad carve-in for third-party IP claims. We should push back to limit indemnity to claims arising from Redwood's gross negligence or willful misconduct and propose the following language: "Redwood's indemnity obligations shall be limited to claims arising directly from Redwood's gross negligence or willful misconduct, and Redwood shall not be liable for Customer modifications of the model or misuse."

2) MSA §4.3 (retention) — ACME proposed 365 days. We can accept 180 days operationally, but request a data export clause to satisfy audit needs. Proposed: 180 days retention + export on request within 15 business days.

3) Order Form pricing table — Marissa, please confirm whether there is a stepped discount at 4M tokens or whether we keep the current per-token rate and handle credits separately.

Minor: standardize definitions ("Customer Data" vs "Customer Content"), remove ambiguous SLA language in Appendix B, and sync Exhibit A naming. I put suggested redline comments into redline_suggestions_20280611.docx and will produce a clean counter-redline PDF after we align on the indemnity and retention language.

If we agree to the limits above, I'll circulate the counter-redline on 2028-06-13 for internal review and to send externally on 2028-06-14.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer

Dana — quick note from the commercial side. We ran the numbers for the proposed 4M tokens/month uplift and a few options:

- Option A (preferred): Maintain per-token list price; volume credit applied monthly above 2M tokens (4M run-rate -> blended ~12% credit).
- Option B: Discounted committed tier for 4M/month with a 6% committed discount and a 12-month minimum spend.

We think Option A keeps flexibility for ACME while respecting Redwood's yield. If procurement prefers an order with committed spend, we can do Option B but would need an explicit minimum purchase line on the Order Form.

If legal is OK with Karthik's proposed indemnity and 180-day retention, we'll incorporate those changes and send a counter-redline. Can we do a 20-minute sync Thu 2028-06-14 to confirm? If so, Hannah — can you propose a time?

Thanks,

Marissa Cole

- Retention: 180 days + export within 15 business days is acceptable.
- Pricing: procurement prefers Option A (per-token rate + monthly volume credit).

Next items for execution:
1) Please send the counter-redline PDF and an Order Form with Option A pricing applied.
2) We'll aim to sign and issue PO the week of 2028-06-24. If you can provide a DocuSign envelope, that will speed internal approvals.
